purpose: Turn a HEPData table (and its covariance or correlation table) into a dataset-record with its HEPData identifiers, and write a binned dataset-record or prediction back out as a HEPData submission, without retyping numbers

tools.name: HEPData submission table format (JSON; YAML with PyYAML)
tested_versions: synthetic tables in the HEPData independent_variables / dependent_variables layout (no real record fetched: hepdata.net is not reachable from E4)

tools.name: HEPData submission writer (submission.yaml and table YAML; hepdata_lib engine optional)
tested_versions: hepdata-validator 0.3.6 accepts the output of both engines; hepdata_lib 0.21.0; synthetic records only, read back by hepdata_record.py with the same numbers

environment: E4 and E2 (docs/capability-matrix.md): Python 3.13, standard library only for JSON input and the plain writer; PyYAML for YAML input; hepdata_lib 0.21.0 and hepdata-validator 0.3.6 for the optional engine and check
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; it stays demonstrated-on-synthetic-data until a real HEPData export is read and its numbers checked against the paper
